text:
ryan: Observing intermittent gRPC streaming stalls between gpu-worker-12 -> gpu-worker-08 on east-west flows. Streams stall ~1.5s then resume, manifests in our model-predict streams.

maria: Same cluster? any overlays in front of those nodes (calico/geneve/vxlan)?

ryan: yes, calico with geneve overlay on that node pool. tcpdump on gpu-worker-08 shows repeated 'ICMP frag needed, mtu 1500' from leaf switch when sending 9000-byte segments.

sam: quick snip from node: `ip link show geneve0 mtu 1450` — looks like tunnel MTU reduced by encapsulation. kernel GSO/GRO might be coalescing large packets that then exceed path MTU after encapsulation.

nina: this is classic: host sends large GSO frames, geneve adds 50-60 bytes, DF set -> 'frag needed' -> upstream drops -> gRPC stream stalls until retransmit.

ryan: repro steps I used: run qps stream between pods, tcpdump on host: `tcpdump -i eth0 -s0 -w /tmp/trace.pcap port 50051` then filter for ICMP frag-needed.

maria: short-term mitigation: disable GRO on the egress interface for affected nodes or reduce GSO size. can you try `ethtool -K eth0 gro off` on gpu-worker-08 and see if streams stabilise?

sam: also tried: `ip link set geneve0 mtu 8900` on a test node — that fixed the icmp frag-needed and streaming became stable (no stalls). but need to be careful: some leaf switches/routers can't handle jumbo on tunnels.

ryan: applied `ethtool -K eth0 gro off` on gpu-worker-08; stream stalls dropped to zero during a 10m run. cpu had small bump but acceptable for short-lived jobs.

devops-bot: Alert: pod gpu-predictor-3 experienced 120s latency spike (detected by latency-monitor) — correlated with earlier ICMP events.

nina: plan: 1) immediately roll a DaemonSet that toggles GRO off on the affected nodepool as hotfix; 2) audit network devices for tunnel mtu capability; 3) update CNI config to set geneve tunnel_mtu to 9000-encap if supported; 4) long term, schedule hostpath/hostnetwork option for RDMA-enabled GPU nodes to avoid overlay if they require low-latency/high-throughput.

maria: ops runbook note: add test in canary for large-payload streaming over overlay after any kernel or CNI bump. include `ping -M do -s` checks for DF+encap path.

sam: I'll open a PR for a DaemonSet + node-selector (gpu-nodepool) to disable GRO temporarily and add rollout rollback docs.

ryan: thanks — after the DaemonSet patch, i'll run longer stress to validate. tagging infra oncall for visibility. :eyes:
